SEARCH
Package edu.kit.datamanager.takita.mainpage.search

Interface ISearchIndexService

All Known Implementing Classes:
SearchIndexService
@Service @ApplicationScope public interface ISearchIndexService
Interface for class SearchIndexService, contains logic for handling the search index in Spring.Data.
